title: npis: Vectorized NPIs for R — npis-package
text: S3 vctrs class representing National Provider Identifier, unique 10-digit identification number assigned healthcare providers United States, mandated Health Insurance Portability Accountability Act (HIPAA).

title: npis: Vectorized NPIs for R — npis-package
text: NPI must meet specifications detailed Final Rule Standard Unique Health Identifier Health Care Providers (69 FR 3434), published 2004-01-23. NPI must consist 9 numeric digits followed 1 numeric check digit. NPI must embedded intelligence. NPI format check digit calculation must compatible card issuer identifier standard health identification card. card issuer identifier must unique, NPI must avoid collisions possible card issuer identifiers. NPIs therefore initially issued first digit 1 2. digits exclusive NPI. Within constraints (4), NPI generation must employ scattering algorithm uses possible numeric combinations beginning 1 2. NPI generated must unique, without requiring database access verification.

title: npis: Vectorized NPIs for R — npis-package
text: NPI check digit calculated using Luhn algorithm computing modulus 10 "double-add-double" check digit, recognized ISO standard (ISO/IEC 7812). NPI used card issuer identifier, prefixed 80840, 80 indicates Health Applications 840 indicates United States. check digit always calculated prefix present. accomplished simply adding constant 24 check digit calculation NPI used without prefix.
